visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) At an airport check-in area, a person dressed in black leans over a silver metallic suitcase placed on the tiled floor. The suitcase features an integrated digital display showing weight measurements. The camera zooms in on the display as the person presses a button. (2) The scene shifts to the airline check-in counter where the same silver suitcase is placed on the professional scale. The digital display on the counter scale matches the reading shown on the suitcase's own display. A young man in a grey jacket and black mask waves to the camera. (3) In a cluttered indoor storage room filled with cardboard boxes, a man wearing a white tank top and black-rimmed glasses excitedly unboxes a large carton. He reveals a light blue suitcase with a gold marble texture. He demonstrates the transparent protective cover and points out the digital scale interface on the side. (4) The man illustrates how to use the built-in scale by laying the suitcase flat on the floor, pointing to the sensors on the back. A fast-motion montage follows, showing him packing a vast array of plush dolls and packaged snacks into the large suitcase on a bed. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing the internal organization of two different suitcase models labeled with different travel destinations. The video concludes with a series of static product catalog slides displaying various colors and technical specifications of the Flexflow luggage series.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An airport check-in terminal with counters and weighing scales; an indoor storage or studio room packed with brown cardboard shipping boxes and shelves; a bedroom with a large bed used for packing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music plays as the video begins. A male voice speaks with high energy, detailing the accuracy of the suitcase scale at an airport. Background includes faint airport echoes and the percussive rolling of luggage wheels. (2) A transition whoosh leads into a studio setting. The speaker's voice becomes more intimate but remains highly animated. Sounds of cardboard tearing and plastic rustling are clearly audible as he unboxes the item. (3) The BGM shifts to a playful, video-game style track with strong synthesized beats during the packing montage. Rapid-fire speech describes the volume of items being packed, punctuated by short 'ding' sound effects for visual emphasis. (4) The final segment features a calmer, more narrative vocal delivery over a steady background loop. The speaker explains the battery compliance and purchase information, concluding with a celebratory shout as the music swells slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Unboxing -> Performance Testing -> Technical Specs -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the innovative 'self-weighing' feature and large storage capacity of Flexflow suitcases to encourage viewers to purchase them through a group-buy or promotional link.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator unboxes the product, demonstrates its unique features in detail, and explicitly mentions a group-buy promotion ('林進團').
